verdict.rationale: Official docs cover upgrading an existing Next.js codebase in two ways: codemods to apply changes when new features are released, and a guide for moving from the Pages Router to the App Router. No step-by-step guide for moving between version numbers appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit version-to-version upgrade guides (e.g., per major release), detail on breaking changes and upgrade steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the upgrade experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow an official upgrade guide to move my existing project to a newer version

citations.quote: Use codemods to upgrade your Next.js codebase when new features are released.
Learn how to upgrade your existing Next.js application from the Pages Router to the App Router.
